summary.text: Brittni Packard is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Republican Rick Taggart.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother, advocate and community organizer who has worked within the justice system alongside justice-impacted youth.

paragraphs.text: Brittni Packard earned a high school diploma from Montrose High School and a bachelor's degree from Colorado Mesa University in 2015, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as law student.
She advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Packard said her campaign centers on the principle "people before profit," and she listed lowering everyday costs and raising wages, protecting and expanding access to healthcare, and expanding Colorado's Universal Pre-K to include daycare as her key messages.
She named healthcare, childcare and civil rights as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
